definitions.explanation: The counter reading for one of something flat, such as paper, plates, photos, or clothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一枚|いちまい}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me one sheet of paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一枚|いちまい}⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一枚|いちまい}⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。

notes:
{一枚|いちまい} is the reading for "one" with the counter ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧, used for flat objects.

THINGS COUNTED WITH {枚|まい}:
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧: paper
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: photos
- ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧: tickets
- ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: plates
- ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: shirts
- CD/DVD: discs
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧: futons

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一枚|いちまい}⟦{上手|うわて}→上手：27458_uwate⟧: one step ahead, more skilled
- {一枚|いちまい}{岩|いわ}: monolithic, united as one
- {一枚|いちまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧: a single picture

RELATED COUNTERS:
- ⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧: two flat objects
- ⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧: how many flat objects
